# Hex

Hex is a collaborative data workspace that combines SQL, Python, and R notebooks for analytics and data science

Category: Data. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/hex/.

## Actions

- **Create Cell**: Create a new cell in the draft version of a Hex project.
- **Create Collection**: Create a new collection in the Hex workspace.
- **Deactivate User**: Deactivates a user in the Hex workspace.
- **Delete Cell**: Permanently delete a cell from the draft version of a project.
- **Delete Group**: Deletes a group from the Hex workspace.
- **Delete Guide Draft**: Deletes a guide draft by ID from Hex.
- **Edit Group**: Edit a group's name and/or members in Hex.
- **Get Project** (read-only): Get metadata about a single Hex project.
- **Get Project Runs** (read-only): Retrieve the status of API-triggered runs for a specific Hex project.
- **Get Run Status** (read-only): Retrieve the status of a specific Hex project run.
- **List Cells** (read-only): List all cells from the draft version of a Hex project.
- **List Collections** (read-only): Retrieve all collections in the workspace with pagination support.
- **List groups** (read-only): List all groups in the Hex workspace with pagination support.
- **List Hex Projects** (read-only): List all viewable Hex projects with pagination and filtering support.
- **List Users** (read-only): List all users in the Hex workspace with pagination support.
- **Run Project**: Trigger a run of the latest published version of a Hex project.
- **Update Cell**: Update a cell's source code and/or data connection in Hex.
- **Upsert Guide Draft**: Update or create guide drafts by filePath.
- **Cancel Run**: Cancel a project run that is in progress.
- **Create Group**: Create a new group in the Hex workspace.
- **Edit Collection**: Edit a collection's name, description, and sharing settings in Hex.
- **Edit Project Sharing Collections**: Add a project to collections or remove it from collections.
- **Edit Project Sharing Groups**: Edit project sharing settings for groups in Hex.
- **Edit Project Sharing Settings**: Edit project sharing settings for workspace members and public web access.
- **Edit Project Sharing Users**: Edit project sharing settings for individual users in Hex.
- **Get Cell** (read-only): Get a single cell by ID from the draft version of a Hex project.
- **Get collection** (read-only): Get information about a specific collection in Hex.
- **Get Group** (read-only): Retrieve information about a specific Hex group.
- **List Data Connections** (read-only): List all data connections in the Hex workspace with pagination support.
- **Publish Guide Drafts**: Publish all currently drafted guides or specific guides by ID.
- **Update Project Status**: Add or remove a status (including endorsements) from a Hex project.
